title: Eazeebox co-founder Srinivas Shanbhogue passes away
summary: Shanbhogue spent two decades at Schneider Electric before building Eazeebox, a Bengaluru startup that helps neighbourhood electrical shops restock from multiple brands through a single app.
llm_summary: Srinivas Shanbhogue, co‑founder of Bengaluru‑based startup Eazeebox, has died. After a 20‑year stint at Schneider Electric, he launched Eazeebox to simplify inventory management for local electrical shops, letting them order from multiple brands through a single app. The platform aims to modernise the traditional, fragmented supply chain for small‑scale retailers.
